New users of a drug (simple layer)

Source: R/simple_v2.R
omop_new_users.Rd

The population of first-time users after a washout: drug exposures of drug are grouped into eras (omop_era, 30-day gap, by), the index is the era start selected by select (default "first_eligible": the earliest era that meets the criteria), the episode ends at the era end (omop_end("interval_end")), and the criteria require washout_days days of prior observation (omop_observed(before = washout_days)) and no exposure in the washout_days days before the index (omop_has_not(rx, window = omop_window(-washout_days, -1))). washout_days = 0 adds no criteria. A parameterized washout is expanded after binding or default resolution; zero keeps independently supplied population and study requirements.

Usage

omop_new_users(
  drug,
  washout_days = 365L,
  select = "first_eligible",
  by = "ingredient"
)

Arguments

drug

Concept IDs, an omop_concept_set, the name of a registry concept set, or an omop_event() over drug_exposure.

washout_days

Washout in days (a non-negative integer).

select

Index selection (see omop_index).

by

Era grouping: "ingredient" (default), "concept" or "event".

Value

An omop_population with id "new_users" (rename with p$id <- ...); omop_study uses it as its index and ANDs its own requirements.

See also

omop_study, omop_era, omop_index

Examples

metf <- omop_concept_set(1503297, descendants = TRUE, name = "metformin")
omop_new_users(metf, washout_days = 365)
